card.name: Words after about, of, to before a second party
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "the", "with", "by" or "they", and sometimes "drugs", right before a second item or other party is named. Seen after verbs or nouns like "concentrations of" and "co-administered", and in general prose.

modes.label: The before the other party
modes.description: The word "the" before "other", "second" or a named substrate or party.
modes.example: Stand up, bow, and tell all the good things you can about<< the>> other person, his hobbies, good qualities

modes.label: Drug interaction wording
modes.description: "drugs" or "with" in interaction sentences, just before the interacting drug is described.
modes.example: Co-administration of clarithromycin can alter the concentrations of other<< drugs>>. The potential for drug-drug interactions

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "by" or "they" that lead into a list or second group.
modes.example: publishing works<< by>> Katherine Mansfield, T. S.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated to each other.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come just before the text names another person, group or drug.
